current_evidence: The council's live 'Planning application process' page still points applicants to the 'validation checklist guide (PDF 174KB)' (Validation Information Guide, December 2012; that page's link uses the older media/228419/ path for the same document). A web search found no newer county local list.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link is the list the council currently publishes, but that list is badly out of date (Updated December 2012). It cites revoked or superseded instruments: the North West Regional Spatial Strategy 2008, DMPO 2010, the Site Waste Management Plans Regulations 2008 (repealed 2013) and PPS-era guidance. Since it has not been reviewed within the last 2 years as DMPO 2015 art. 11(3)(c) requires, its local items may not be enforceable as validation requirements. The workbook's 'Outdated (>2y)? Yes' flag is correct, but this should be stated plainly.
issues.evidence: Guide header 'Updated December 2012'; Parking Provision cites 'North West of England Plan Regional Spatial Strategy September 2008'

issues.detail: Grokbot captured about 15 of the 36 local items (sections 8-43). Missing: Daylight/sunlight assessment (s10, where adverse impact on adjoining properties or gardens is possible); Economic statement (s11, major employment-generating proposals); Energy statement (s12); Land contamination assessment (s17, known/suspected contamination or vulnerable end use); Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment (s20); Mineral working and restoration (s23, all mineral working: restoration, aftercare, environmental standards); Mineral extraction (s24, mineral applications using the County mineral form); Noise impact assessment (s25, development likely to disturb occupiers, noise-sensitive uses near sources, and all minerals or waste operations); Open space assessment (s27, development within open space); Photographs and photomontages (s29, demolition of a building or development affecting a conservation area/listed building); Planning obligations draft Heads of Terms (s30); Planning statement (s31, mandatory where inappropriate development in the Green Belt); Public Rights of Way (s32); Statement of Community Involvement (s34); Telecommunications supplementary information with ICNIRP declaration (s37, masts within a minerals or waste operation); Town centre uses (s38); Travel plan (s40, significant transport implications); Waste management details (s43, required in many cases where significant effects are likely).
issues.evidence: Validation Information Guide sections 8-43; also listed on the council's 'Validation Checklist: Full Planning Permission' (Local List items 8-43)

issues.detail: 'Minerals & waste (county)' and 'County own devt (Reg 3)' are marked '(none)', yet these are the only applications Lancashire County Council determines as LPA, and many local items target them directly. Mineral working and restoration (s23) and Mineral extraction (s24) apply to all mineral applications. Noise (s25), Ventilation/extraction (s42) and Telecoms (s37) name minerals or waste operations, and Waste details (s43) apply to waste development. Structural survey (s35) gives 'school development applications' as its example, which is County own development. Instead, everything is put under 'Full planning' with 'INFERRED' notes.
issues.evidence: s25: noise assessment for 'minerals or waste operations'; s35: 'for example, school development applications'

issues.detail: The Lighting Assessment is placed under 'Listed building consent' only because the trigger mentions 'a listed building'. The trigger is publicly accessible development near residential property, a listed building, a conservation area or open countryside where external lighting is provided. Listed building consent is not a County application type. The Householder and Listed building consent rows are not relevant to a county minerals/waste/Reg 3 authority and should be N/A rather than '(none)'.
issues.evidence: s21: 'Proposals involving the provision of publicly accessible developments, in the vicinity of residential property, a listed building or a conservation area, or open countryside'

issues.detail: 'Ventilation / Extraction details' reuses the Odour/dust excerpt ('Odour and Dust Assessments may be required ... 27.'). The real s42 trigger is minerals or waste management operations, and significant retail/business/industrial/leisure developments with substantial ventilation or extraction equipment. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' is really the Site Waste Management Plan (a construction-waste plan, s33), and the waste-development requirement (s43) is missing. The Heritage excerpt says only that 'scope ... will vary' and leaves out the triggers (setting of heritage assets, in/adjacent to a conservation area, ground disturbance in an Area of Archaeological Potential or major development, removal of important hedgerows). The FRA excerpt leaves out non-minor development in a notified critical drainage area. The Ecology excerpt is a mid-sentence fragment without the triggers (designated sites, protected species, demolition of older buildings/roof spaces, removal of trees, hedgerows or ponds).
issues.evidence: s42 Ventilation/extraction statement; s14 FRA; s16 Heritage statement; s9 Biodiversity survey

issues.detail: The Discharge of conditions rows 'Photographs / Photomontages' and 'Planning Statement' use a tick-box row label from the approval-of-details checklist ('Section 2 Photographs and photomontages Section 29 Planning Statement Section 31 ... Tick not included'). That label is not a trigger and does not say these are required for condition discharge.

All 6 tab_items are process text or fragments: 'Alternatively you can use hard copy forms (see below).'; 'You should check the validation checklist guide (PDF 174KB)...'; the 'Once we validate an application we will ... personal information' privacy boilerplate; 'The standard application form ... available electronically and as a paper copy' (national); 'Link to the Protected Species leaflet: let.pdf Link to the Supplementary Planning Guidance ... e 10.' (broken link fragment); 'Advice should be sought as to the number of copies ... of an EIA/ES ... 15.' The app-type row 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is only encouragement ('The County Council encourages applicants...'), not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Planning application process web page; guide s1, s9, s13

issues.detail: 'Floor plans / Elevations' ('Blank elevations must also be included') and 'Design and Access Statement' are national-list items (sections 3 and 6 of the guide's 'National List Essential Requirement'), not local requirements.
issues.evidence: Full application checklist: 'National List Essential Requirement' items 1-7

issues.detail: 'Odour / Dust / Vibration assessment' and 'Ventilation / Extraction details' have the identical Odour/dust excerpt (s26), so they count one item twice.

summary: Grokbot's link is still the only local list Lancashire County Council publishes, and the December 2012 date is correct, but the guide is 14 years old and cites revoked policy. The extraction misses about half of the local items, including all the minerals and waste requirements, wrongly shows Minerals & waste and County Reg 3 development as having no local requirements, and fills the tab with process text.
